payload.acceptance_criteria:
WHEN orch next --session NAME runs and <orch store>/queue/NAME.md holds a "- " line, THE COMMAND SHALL print the top line and move it, with a time, to <orch store>/queue/NAME.taken.jsonl.
WHEN that queue file has no "- " line or is missing, THE COMMAND SHALL print: review the oldest waiting lane in your project (orch status), else report 'queue empty' to the Orchestrator.
WHEN the Stop hook runs for the session named Orchestrator, for a session with no queue file, with stop_hook_active true, or while orch state says the session works on an item, THE HOOK SHALL allow the stop and write nothing.
WHEN the Stop hook runs in any other case, THE HOOK SHALL return decision block with the reason: Next item from the Orchestrator's queue: <line>. Start it now; report when done.
The hook reads the session name the way orch-state-hook does, serves Claude Code and the Codex Stop event, and a test in tests/ proves each branch.
payload.description:
## Context
Owner-approved 2026-11-20 09:05 UTC, relayed by the Orchestrator. A session that ends its turn with work queued for it takes the next item instead of going idle. The queue is a per-session Markdown file in the orch store; the Stop hook blocks at most once per turn. Read the current Claude Code and Codex hook docs (interface-facts) before building.
payload.title: Give each session its next queued item with orch next and a Stop hook

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
In a git repository, init installs the skills and creates a local vault in the user state folder, named by its genesis commit, and the committed .basicly-tracker.toml holds no absolute path.
The genesis name is the same in every clone, tested with a repository with no commit, one with several root commits, and a shallow clone.
When init finds an existing ledger, issues.jsonl, br or beans source, it creates the vault, does not attach, and names migrate as the next command; outside a git repository it installs the skills and names the repository step.
A vault moved before this change, whose toml names its URL, still resolves to its existing clone, tested with the real old toml shape.

payload.name: title
payload.value: (a3) Create a path-free local vault at init, named by its genesis commit
